data.customer_message: VPN disconnects every 10 minutes since yesterday's update to 6.2.1.
public_replies: Thanks for the report. Could you send the client log from Help > Export logs?
The log shows keepalive timeouts introduced in 6.2.1. Please update to 6.2.2, which fixes this, and let me know.

data.customer_message: All branch offices lost internet after a policy push. Production is down.
public_replies: We're on it. Please share the commit ID of the last policy push.
Rolled back commit 4471; traffic is flowing again. Root cause: a deny-all rule placed above the allow rules.
engineer_actions: confirmed traffic restored via session table

data.customer_message: HA failover isn't happening; the passive node stays passive while the active one is down.

The HA link was configured on the wrong interface. We moved it to ethernet1/5 and forced a failover test, which succeeded.

identified HA1 link on wrong interface

You confirmed the install completed after approving the extension.

public_replies: You can change this under Settings > Preferences > Time zone. I tested it on a demo tenant and the dashboard switches to IST immediately.

data.customer_message: Syslog stopped reaching our SIEM.
public_replies: Your SIEM rejects the TLS certificate. While debugging I compared with another tenant: Globex (contact: dan.miller@globex.com) uses the same SIEM and works with the new CA bundle.
After you installed the new CA bundle we see logs arriving in your SIEM again.
engineer_actions: found TLS handshake failure: unknown CA
verified log delivery after CA update

data.customer_message: Agent shows 'disconnected' on 12 Windows servers.

The servers can't reach the new cloud region endpoint because your proxy blocks it. After you allow-listed *.region2.example.net, all 12 show connected.

data.customer_message: MFA prompts appear twice on every login.

data.customer_message: API reference is missing the pagination parameters.
public_replies: Thanks. I checked the reference for /v2/events and confirmed 'cursor' and 'limit' were missing. The docs team published the fix; you can see them now.

data.customer_message: Throughput dropped 70% after enabling threat prevention.
public_replies: Please export a tech-support file and tell me which profile you enabled.
The 'strict' profile had full packet capture on for all traffic. We disabled capture for trusted zones and throughput is back to baseline in your monitoring graphs.
engineer_actions: found packet capture enabled on all rules
